items.title: BNY expands digital asset custody platform in Europe
items.summary: The move follows the addition of BNY’s European banking entity to the EU’s MiCA register in July.

items.title: Not slowing down at 30: How CIBC Mellon is building its own tech future
items.summary: New technology leadership, its own cloud platform, four client launches and digital asset custody on the way: CEO Mal Cullen tells Global Custodian why the CIBC–BNY joint venture is using its 30th year to build rather than reflect.

items.title: Fireside Friday with… Transcend’s Bimal Kadikar
